nu: There are four kinds of grammar that can be recited in combination with the consonant and the vowel. There (1) Nibb ပါတ်na is (a) contemplation = paradox, (b) misconception - doubt, (c) questioning = problem, problem, (d) expressing displeasure - nonsense, (e) name == name, (f) indeed = = Ekantha, (g) Intermediate == Anutsavana, (h) Divide-Limit == = Avadharana, (i) In the first == Hathava meanings. It is kind. Tipi, 12, 2001 + 1002 + 1003 nu Noti [(Nu + Kwi)] Praiseworthy (honor).
nuda: [Nuda+a]  CL=7 (1) One who drives out. (2) May he drive out or dispel. See – nudati - (1).
nudati:
[Nu+a+ti]  CL=7 (1) He drives out or removes. (2) He crushes.
[Nuda peraṇa, nuda khepe vā. Dhāna, ṭī. 744. Dhātvattha. 217.(rū,nhā. 294). Nuda peraṇe. Peraṇaṃ cuṇṇikaraṇaṃ pisanaṃ, nudati. Nīti, dhā. 105.]

nuhi: [Nuha+ī]  CL=1 Nuha Uggirane; Nadadi. ဒါန်၊ ထီ. 587.] A great harp.
nuhipattasaṇṭhāna: [Nuhipatta+saṇṭhāna] (ti) CL=8 something which look like Aloe Vera.
nujja:
[Nuda+ya+ti]  CL=7 (1) May it be removed.
[Da khepe. Rū, nhā. 294, 354, 385.  Kaccaya. 444. Rū, 511. Nīti, sutta. 524. Kaccaya. 479. Rū. 452. Moga, 6. 48. Nīti, sutta. 960.]
nunna:
[Nuda+ta]  CL=7 (1) That which has been driven out. (2) That which has been removed.
[Nuda peraṇe, nudakhepe vā, to, tassa inno. Dhāna, ṭī. 744.]
nupura:
[Ūna+pūra(=pūra+ṇa)]  CL=7 (1) (1) An anklet, an ornament worn on the ankle. (2) The bracelet that is worn on the wrist.
[Ūnaṃ pādaṃ pūretīti nūpuro. Vaṇṇavipariyāyo. Dhāna, ṭī. 288.(ṇiura-ṇūura-prā)].
nuta:
[Nu+ta]  CL=7 (A) He should be praised. (B) That which should be crushed. (C) That which should be put down or driven out.
[Nu thutiyaṃ nuto. Nīti, dhā. 112. Nuda+ta. Nuda peraṇe, nuda khepe vā, to, nutto. Nutopi. Dhāna, ṭī. 744. Nuda peraṇe, peraṇaṃ cuṇṇikaraṇaṃ pisanaṃ. Nīti, dhā. 105.]
